en: A black and white image showing a picturesque Alpine village nestled in a valley, surrounded by forested hills and high, rocky mountains in the background. The village contains scattered buildings, fields, and a prominent church with a steeple. Text at the bottom provides information about the location and elevation. The postcard has an old-fashioned look, suggesting it is from the mid-20th century.
